heard: The Milky Way's black hole erupted 350 years ago. It usually sits quiet, 4 million times heavier than our sun. Gas whips around its edge near the speed of light. Orbits take mere minutes, making the disk change constantly. Supercomputers needed five full years to build this first image. Then astronomers found x-rays echoing off a nearby gas cloud. The echo revealed a blast one million times brighter than now. That sleeping monster can wake up at any moment.
